name: Carilex
summary: Carilex Medical, Inc. specializes in the development and production of healthcare devices designed for the prevention of pressure ulcers and overall wound care management. The company's offerings include advanced therapeutic air mattresses, specialized seating cushions, and systems for negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT). Carilex Medical, Inc. was established on May 23, 2012, and is based in Taoyuan, China.
